import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a scatter plot with species as the hue
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='petal_length', y='petal_width', hue='species', s=100, alpha=0.8)

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Iris Species by Petal Dimensions', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Species', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Create a scatter plot with species as the hue
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='petal_length', y='petal_width', hue='species', s=100, alpha=0.8)

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Iris Species by Petal Dimensions', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Species', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
